documents.title: Guidance for Appropriate Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools at Stevens
documents.summary: A short IT-division guidance sheet for faculty and staff on using generative AI. It sorts Stevens data into four classes, allows Stevens data only in licensed tools, and flags grading, personnel and disciplinary uses for extra review. It says nothing about student coursework.
documents.stance_why: It limits use: "Use of Stevens data is only permissible with licensed AI tools" and new uses need "prior approval from your supervisor". AI is allowed only under narrow listed conditions, so restrict. It sets no course-level stance.

units.why: "ensure it aligns with Stevens' Information Security Policy, Privacy Policy, and any other relevant policies" binds AI users to existing policy; P77 fits, not P56 since it is a compliance duty.
units.anchor: ensure it aligns with Stevens' Information Security Policy

units.why: "Always consider the risks and ethical implications" asks users to weigh ethics before using AI; closest is P53 (ethical concerns), though it names no specific harm.
units.anchor: Always consider the risks and ethical implications
units.fit_note: Asks users to consider risks and ethics generally; names no specific bias, harm or environmental cost.

units.why: "seek prior approval from your supervisor and/or department chair for new AI uses in your work" requires approval before a new AI use; this is review of AI use, so P65 over P80.
units.anchor: seek prior approval from your supervisor and/or department chair for new AI uses
units.fit_note: Approval is by supervisor or chair for each new use in one's work, not an institutional review of vendors or tools.

units.why: "additional consultation may be required" with named offices (Sponsored Projects, General Counsel, HR, IT, Compliance) names who is consulted on AI use; P80 for naming offices that weigh in.
units.policy: Depending on the AI use case, additional consultation may be required with the Office of Sponsored Projects, Office of the General Counsel, Division of Human Resources, Division of Information Technology, and/or the Office of Compliance.
units.fit_note: Names consulting offices but not an owner who enforces or grants exceptions.

units.why: "Key considerations include data sensitivity, regulatory compliance, ethical implications, user consent, data privacy, and intellectual property rights" lists factors to weigh; privacy is the lead, so P50.
units.anchor: data sensitivity, regulatory compliance, ethical implications, user consent, data privacy, and intellectual property rights
units.fit_note: Lists data, consent, compliance and IP considerations together rather than only protecting personal data.

units.why: "Use of Stevens data is only permissible with licensed AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot for Web with Data Protection and Zoom AI Companion" limits Stevens data to licensed tools; P92 as it is institution-wide.
units.anchor: Use of Stevens data is only permissible with licensed AI tools
units.policy: Use of Stevens data is only permissible with licensed AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot for Web with Data Protection and Zoom AI Companion, while logged in via a Stevens account.

units.why: The "Prohibited for AI Use" column lists restricted data such as "Any personally identiﬁable info", passwords and NDA records, so no AI use; P50 protects confidential data.
units.policy: Restricted data, including any personally identifiable information, financial records, records subject to NDAs, intellectual property and passwords, is prohibited for AI use.

units.why: The table defines Public data as "openly accessible and can be shared without restrictions" and sets four data classes (Public, Non-Public, Sensitive, Restricted) used to decide AI use; P05 as named tiers.
units.anchor: This data is openly accessible and can be shared without restrictions.
units.fit_note: Tiers are data classes, not levels of AI use by assessment.

units.why: "Lectures with student identiﬁers" appears under prohibited data, so student-identifiable course content may not go into AI; P49 fits course material.
units.policy: Lectures with student identifiers are prohibited for AI use.
units.fit_note: Addressed to staff and faculty content with student identifiers, not students uploading materials.

units.why: "requires additional review and consideration prior to use in AI" for "grading or assessment of student work" sets a condition on AI-assisted grading; P101 not P46 because it does not bar AI grading.
units.anchor: grading or assessment of student work
units.policy: Grading or assessment of student work requires additional review and consideration prior to use in AI.
units.fit_note: Requires additional review before AI grading but states no further conditions.

units.why: The same sentence adds "disciplinary decision-making" and "personnel" to uses needing review, so decisions about people need extra review; P73 fits.
units.policy: Recruitment, personnel, or disciplinary decision-making requires additional review and consideration prior to use in AI.
units.fit_note: Requires additional review rather than barring AI as sole basis for decisions.

units.why: "any non-public use of non-licensed AI tools with click-through agreements" needs review, a rule on unvetted tools; P65 as review before use.
units.anchor: non-licensed AI tools with click-through agreements
units.policy: Any non-public use of non-licensed AI tools with click-through agreements requires additional review and consideration prior to use in AI.

units.why: "contact Security@Stevens.edu" for privacy, compliance, or security questions names a contact for AI questions; P80.
units.policy: For questions regarding privacy, compliance, or security in the context of AI tools and their use, contact Security@Stevens.edu.
units.fit_note: Names a contact for questions, not an enforcing body.

units.why: "Stevens Generative AI Overview contains several additional resources regarding AI" points to guidance for users; P102.
units.anchor: Stevens Generative AI Overview contains several additional resources regarding AI
units.fit_note: Points to resources; does not impose a duty to stay informed.

notes: Single staff-facing data-use document; no student coursework policy.
